newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asian Banking Corp closes $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Asian Banking Corp closes $100 mln FRN.

text.p: Asian Banking Corp's US$100 million floating rate note issue due 2002 has been completed, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday.
The five-year notes were issued at par to float at 65 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate, and have put options at the end of years three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for participants is 75 basis points.
Seven financial institutions in addition to the lead manager joined the syndication.
Banque Indosuez, Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, BT Asia, KDB Bank (UK), Raiffelsen Zentralbank Osterreich and Sumitomo Finance (Asia) are co-lead managers.
Signing is set for May 12. The payment date is May 16.
